wire.operator_setup.prompt.confirm_phone: Local Operator needs your approval to confirm a phone on this computer.
wire.operator_setup.prompt.remove_phone: Local Operator needs your approval to remove a phone from this computer.
wire.operator_setup.prompt.phone_approva: Local Operator wants to turn on phone approvals for this computer.
wire.operator_setup.title.confirm_phone: Confirm this phone on this computer
wire.operator_setup.title.remove_phone: Remove this phone from this computer
wire.operator_setup.body.phone_approvals: Let phones approve requests on this computer.
wire.operator_setup.refused.privileged: Local Operator is running with administrator rights, so it can't ask you in person. Nothing was changed. Restart Local Operator under your usual account, then try again.
wire.operator_setup.refused.no_password_: This computer can't show a password prompt, so approvals can't be turned on from here.
wire.operator_setup.refused.terminal_can: This terminal app can't show a password prompt, so approvals can't be turned on from it. Use Settings → Phone access in the desktop app instead.
wire.operator_setup.refused.cannot_insta: This computer has no safe place to store phone-approval settings, so approvals can't be turned on here.
wire.operator_setup.refused.in_progress: Phone approvals setup is already running. Answer the password prompt, or wait for it to finish.
wire.operator_setup.refused.key_failed: Something went wrong setting up approvals on this computer, so they weren't turned on. Try again.
wire.operator_setup.refused.unsafe_stagi: Local Operator's setup files changed during setup, so approvals weren't turned on. Try again.
wire.operator_setup.outcome.cancelled: You cancelled the password prompt, so approvals weren't turned on. Try again when you're ready.
wire.operator_setup.outcome.failed: The password prompt didn't finish, so approvals weren't turned on. Try again.
wire.operator_setup.outcome.not_verified: Approvals were set up but aren't working on this computer yet. Try again.
wire.operator_setup.outcome.changed_else: Approvals on this computer were changed elsewhere while the password prompt was open, so nothing was replaced. Try again to check whether they're on.
wire.operator_setup.outcome.on: Phone approvals are on. Each new phone will still ask for your computer's password once.
wire.operator_setup.outcome.already_on: Phone approvals are already on for this computer.
wire.operator_setup.outcome.file_only: Note: on this computer itself, approvals won't ask for a fingerprint or password.
wire.operator_setup.tui.usage: To let phones approve requests on this computer, type /mobile approvals on
wire.operator_setup.tui.approvals_report: tool approvals: {live} (this session) — write and command tools prompt before running; config.yml says {saved} — /approvals {saved} adopts it with the operator's own consent, from this machine (Touch ID) or from a paired phone. But approvals aren't set up on this computer yet, so neither can run until they are. Turn on phone approvals in Settings → Phone access, or with /mobile approvals on in the terminal app.
